proposedOperatorData.name: Rip N Rock
proposedOperatorData.tagline: Coasteering, canyoning, gorge walking, climbing and surfing on the Gower Peninsula and in Waterfall Country, South Wales
proposedOperatorData.description:
Rip N Rock is a small, family-run adventure activity provider based on the Gower Peninsula near Swansea, South Wales. Founded around 2018 (Sally, company director, set it up 'eight years ago' as of a 2026 site read) it has grown into one of Gower's busiest activity operators, now employing over 10 guides.

The company runs coasteering from Rhossili Bay (voted the UK's best beach by TripAdvisor readers in 2014) and around the wider Gower coastline, rock climbing and abseiling at Three Cliffs Bay, and surfing lessons at Rhossili and Llangennith beach. It also runs canyoning and gorge walking trips on the River Mellte and River Sychryd in the Neath Valley ('Waterfall Country' / the 'Celtic Rainforest'), an area at the southern edge of the Brecon Beacons National Park, roughly 30-45 minutes from its Gower base.

Sessions typically run around 3-4 hours including kit fitting (wetsuits, buoyancy aids, helmets provided), with a minimum age of around 10 for coasteering and no stated upper age limit. The business holds a National Coasteering Charter accreditation badge on its site and promotes a 'quality over quantity' approach, recommending early booking in peak season.
proposedOperatorData.uniqueSellingPoint: Small family business with deep local knowledge of Gower's coastline and the Neath Valley 'Waterfall Country', running the full range of Welsh adventure activities (coasteering, canyoning, gorge walking, climbing, abseiling, surfing) from one operator.
